read_scope: Abstract plus relevant introduction and method sections of every selected original

reviews.scope_rationale: Direct distributed learning contribution: FERT uses failed executions to retrieve successful fleet segments for supervised policy updates; FATS coordinates collection, optimization, and policy distribution asynchronously.

Direct data-parallel training systems contribution retrieved through current HF Trending attention; its age does not make this an added background collection. Gradient buckets, autograd hooks, and asynchronous AllReduce address synchronization overhead.
Substantive PEFT scaling contribution beyond incidental LoRA: a causal single-pass feature path plus a batched multi-LoRA kernel supports joint training of many low-rank adapters.

A continual-learning framework that goes beyond passive retrieval by defining feedback-driven memory and management-policy updates, plus behavioral retention/adaptation/transfer evaluation. It keeps base weights fixed; describe it as a framework, not a trained model.
Substantive optimizer-method application: MuSGD combines orthogonalized Muon updates with momentum SGD on multi-dimensional weights and is evaluated under controlled detection training.

A concrete evaluation method for LLM training dynamics: completion-style scaffold adaptation exposes step-level behavior across pretraining checkpoints. It measures capability development rather than proposing an optimizer.

A new efficient model-adaptation architecture: trainable chunk-memory prediction and gated fusion modules learn domain knowledge while the LLM backbone is frozen. This is not merely a retrieval cache.

Empirical analysis of post-training dynamics: varying label-policy insertion routes while holding architecture and optimizer family fixed isolates how supervision provenance changes guardrail benchmark behavior.
Post-training analysis and method: content-matched requests measure stage-specific preference updates, and calibrated accommodation pairs provide a task-specific DPO data construction method.
Substantive efficient-adaptation method beyond incidental LoRA: a learned token gate and token-gated attention jointly adapt a pretrained model for long-context prefill under a small training budget.
